text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"City-wide air-raid sirens indicate an imminent threat of aerial attack or strike.","main_move":"GO_DOWN_INSIDE","main_move_text":"Move down to the lowest available floor or basement and stay in an interior windowless room.","where_to_go":"Ground floor, basement, or windowless interior room of your current building in AC Block.","do_now":[{"text":"Move to the ground floor or a central windowless room immediately using stairs.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_01"]},{"text":"Cover your head and sit against an interior load-bearing wall away from glass windows.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_02"]},{"text":"Keep your emergency bag, mobile phone, and water close at hand.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_03"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not stay on upper floors or stand near exterior windows or glass walls.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_04"]},{"text":"Do not use elevators during an active air raid alert.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_05"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"On an upper floor","text":"Take the stairs down to the ground floor or basement immediately.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_01"]},{"situation":"Outdoors","text":"Enter the nearest sturdy reinforced building or basement shelter right away.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_06"]}],"call":["112","100"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Standard safety response for air-raid siren alerts is well-established.","unknowns":["Specific target area of aerial threat","Duration of the active siren alert"],"valid_while":["Air-raid sirens are active","Until an official all-clear signal is declared"]}
